job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a Hawaii ERS private equity consultant services RFP, not the OPERS investment consulting services RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii Request for Proposals Private Equity Consultant Services RFP 2022-04
Closing date for Receipt of Proposals September 30, 2022 by 4:30 p.m. (H.S.T.)
